integrity: The asymptotic proof is supplied explicitly. Exhaustive finite checks validate n=1 through 6 but are not used to certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics for uniform finite labelled models of the unary identity f^3=f^2 only; fixed-relative-error rather than Gaussian fluctuations. Older broad saddlepoint literature may contain an equivalent special case; priority is not independently established.
title: Three-scale layer concentration in finite unary models of \(f^3=f^2\)
